arxiv-2112-14425.title: Enhanced Optimal Quantum Communication by Generalized Phase Shift Keying Coherent Signal
arxiv-2112-14425.creator: Min Namkung, Jeong San Kim
arxiv-2112-14425.description: Abstract It is well known that the maximal success probability of the binary quantum communication can be improved by using a sub-Poissonian non-standard coherent state as an information carrier. In the present article, we consider the quantum communication with N N -ary phase shift keying ( N N -PSK) signal for an arbitrary positive integer N > 1 N>1 .

arxiv-2305-08963.description: Abstract Abstract \justify Our analysis involves enhancing the \Delta(54) flavor symmetry model with Inverse Seesaw mechanism along with two SM Higgs through the incorporation of distinct flavons. arxiv-2310-10160.title: The Poisson boundary of wreath products
arxiv-2310-10160.creator: Joshua Frisch, Eduardo Silva
arxiv-2310-10160.description: Abstract . We give a complete description of the Poisson boundary of wreath products A ≀ B ≔ ⨁ B A ⋊ B A\wr B\coloneqq\bigoplus_{B}A\rtimes B of countable groups A A and B B , for probability measures μ \mu with finite entropy where lamp configurations stabilize almost surely.

arxiv-2510-23762.title: Control VAR: a counterfactual based approach to inference in macroeconomics
arxiv-2510-23762.creator: Raimondo Pala
arxiv-2510-23762.description: Abstract This paper addresses the challenges of giving a causal interpretation to vector autoregressions (VARs). I show that under independence assumptions VARs can identify average treatment effects, average causal responses, or a mix of the two, depending on the distribution of the policy. But what about situations in which the economist cannot rely on independence assumptions?

britannica-1911-synechism.title: Synechism (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-synechism.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-synechism.description: Article 'Synechism' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 26), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. All understanding of facts consists in generalizing concerning them. The fact that some things are ultimate may be recognized by the synechist without abandoning his standpoint, since synechism is a normative or regulative principle, not a theory of existence. The adjective “synechological” is used in the same general sense; “synechology” is a theory of continuity or universal causation; “synechia” is a term in ophthalmology for a morbid union of parts.

pmc-10521400.title: Delayed diagnosis of pediatric intra-articular epithelioid sarcoma: a case report and literature review
pmc-10521400.creator: Ranran Zhang, Jia Liu, Lin Liu, Yi Lin, Qiuye Zhang
pmc-10521400.description: BackgroundEpithelioid sarcoma (ES) is a rare form of mesenchymal malignancy that rarely occurs in children. Only seven cases of intra-articular epithelioid sarcoma have been reported in the medical literature.Case presentationIn this report, we presented the case of a 13-year-old girl with a delayed diagnosis of ES in the left knee.

pmc-10562940.title: Depressive Symptoms and Mortality Among US Adults
pmc-10562940.creator: Zefeng Zhang, Sandra L. Jackson, Cathleen Gillespie, Robert Merritt, Quanhe Yang
pmc-10562940.description: Key PointsQuestionWhat is the association between depressive symptoms and death from all causes, cardiovascular disease, and ischemic heart disease?FindingsThis cohort study of 23 694 individuals found a higher risk of all-cause, cardiovascular disease, and ischemic heart disease mortality among adults with moderate to severe depressive symptoms compared to those without depressive symptoms.

pmc-10598985.title: The value of co-creating a clinical outcome assessment strategy for clinical trial research: process and lessons learnt
pmc-10598985.creator: Thomas Morel, Karlin Schroeder, Sophie Cleanthous, John Andrejack, Geraldine Blavat, William Brooks, Lesley Gosden, Carroll Siu, Natasha Ratcliffe, Ashley F Slagle
pmc-10598985.description: BackgroundIn support of UCB pharmaceutical research programs, the aim of this research was to implement a novel process for patient involvement in a multidisciplinary research group to co-create a clinical outcome assessment strategy to accurately reflect the experience of people living with early-stage Parkinson’s.

pmc-10620468.title: Projections of mortality risk attributable to short-term exposure to landscape fire smoke in China, 2021–2100: a health impact assessment study
pmc-10620468.creator: Shuhan Lou, Yufu Liu, Yuqi Bai, Fang Li, Guangxing Lin, Lulu Xu, Zhao Liu, Yidan Chen, Xiao Dong, Mengzhen Zhao, Lingyu Wang, Meng Jin, Can Wang, Wenjia Cai, Peng Gong, Yong Luo
pmc-10620468.description: SummaryBackgroundLandscape fire smoke, including smoke from all vegetation burning in natural and cultural landscapes, remains a threat to the health of the population. However, the future health impacts of landscape fire smoke in China have not been sufficiently investigated. We aimed to estimate the mortality risk attributable to landscape fire-related PM2·5 under different scenarios.

pmc-10673091.title: A Simple Technique Using Peri-Prosthetic Irrigation Improves Implant Salvage Rates in Immediate Implant-Based Breast Reconstruction
pmc-10673091.creator: Manoj Srinivas Gowda, Sadaf Jafferbhoy, Sekhar Marla, Sankaran Narayanan, Soni Soumian, Edgaras Stankevičius, Dinesh K Thekkinkattil
pmc-10673091.description: Background and objectives: Implant-related complications leading to implant loss contribute to major morbidity in immediate breast reconstruction (IBR). Various techniques have been advocated to improve rates of reconstruction salvage. The objective of our study was to assess if a peri-prosthetic irrigation system was an effective adjunct to the conventional wash-out technique in improving reconstruction salvage rates.

pmc-10758073.title: Molecular Detectıon of Canine Leishmaniasis in Northern Anatolia, Turkiye
pmc-10758073.creator: Banucicek Yucesan, Ozcan Ozkan, Sinem Tuncer, Zekeriya Ocal
pmc-10758073.description: Background:Canin leishmaniasis (CanL), mostly caused by Leishmania infantum, is one of the most important vector-borne diseases in dogs in the Mediterranean region. In this study, we aimed to determine the disease profile in this region by firstly making microscopic and then molecular analyzes in the samples taken from the dogs.

pmc-11439281.title: Virologic suppression rate and associated factors for third-line HIV treatment in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia
pmc-11439281.creator: Abel Andargie Berhane, Hawibilisuma Fituma Chimdesa, Atalel Fentahun Awedew, Nahom Addisu Bekele, Henok Mulatu Teferi, Getachew W/Yohannes
pmc-11439281.description: BackgroundHIV/AIDS has left a profound impact, leading to significant mortality, morbidity, economic strain, and disability on a global scale. The introduction of antiretroviral therapy (ART) has played a pivotal role in mitigating the economic burden of HIV and enhancing overall productivity.

pmc-11463000.title: Clinical validation of a deep learning-based approach for preoperative decision-making in implant size for total knee arthroplasty
pmc-11463000.creator: Ki-Bong Park, Moo-Sub Kim, Do-Kun Yoon, Young Dae Jeon
pmc-11463000.description: BackgroundOrthopedic surgeons use manual measurements, acetate templating, and dedicated software to determine the appropriate implant size for total knee arthroplasty (TKA). This study aimed to use deep learning (DL) to assist in deciding the femoral and tibial implant sizes without manual manipulation and to evaluate the clinical validity of the DL decision by comparing it with conventional manual procedures.

pmc-11580390.title: Chemical quantification of N-acyl alanine methyl ester (NAME) production and impact on temporal gene expression patterns in Roseovarius tolerans EL-164
pmc-11580390.creator: Janina Leinberger, Diana Koteska, Judith Boldt, Jörn Petersen, Sahana Shivaramu, Jürgen Tomasch, Stefan Schulz, Thorsten Brinkhoff
pmc-11580390.description: BackgroundPrevious studies have identified structurally diverse N-acyl amino acid methyl esters (NAMEs) in culture extracts of Roseovarius tolerans EL-164 (Roseobacteraceae). NAMEs are structural analogues of the common signaling compounds N-acyl homoserine lactones (AHLs), but do not participate in AHL-mediated signaling. NAMEs show minor antialgal and antimicrobial activity, but whether this activity serves as the primary ecological role remains unclear.

pmc-11598166.title: Array Radar Three-Dimensional Forward-Looking Imaging Algorithm Based on Two-Dimensional Super-Resolution †
pmc-11598166.creator: Jinke Dai, Weijie Sun, Xinrui Jiang, Di Wu
pmc-11598166.description: Radar imaging is a technology that uses radar systems to generate target images. It transmits radio waves, receives the signal reflected back by the target, and realizes imaging by analyzing the target’s position, shape, and motion information. The three-dimensional (3D) forward-looking imaging of missile-borne radar is a branch of radar imaging.

pmc-12421401.title: B cell CLL/lymphoma 10 promotes colorectal cancer cell proliferation and regulates cuproptosis sensitivity through the NF-κB signaling pathway
pmc-12421401.creator: Peng-Tuo Xiao, Chang-Feng Li, Yuan-Da Liu, Jing Zhong, Xi-Lun Cui, Chang Liu, Wei Yang
pmc-12421401.description: BACKGROUNDColorectal cancer (CRC) is a major global health burden. B cell CLL/lymphoma 10 (BCL10), a key component of the caspase recruitment domain protein-BCL10-mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue lymphoma paracaspase complexes, is upregulated in CRC and associated with poor patient prognosis, suggesting its potential role in CRC development and progression.

pmc-12566111.title: Methodological Insights into the Occurrence, Conversion, and Control of Polychlorinated Dibenzo-p-Dioxins/Dibenzofurans from Waste Incineration
pmc-12566111.creator: Ruoru Xu, Xuetong Qu, Yunfei He, Feifei Chen, Yuchi Zhong, Hangjun Zhang, Jiafeng Ding, Jibo Dou, Giorgio Vilardi
pmc-12566111.description: With the acceleration of global urbanization, polychlorinated dibenzo-p-dioxins/dibenzofurans (PCDD/Fs), as a by-product of solid waste incineration, have attracted more and more attention for their environmental pollution and health hazards. By describing the generation and transformation mechanism of PCDD/Fs, this review focuses on the methods to control the generation of PCDD/Fs and reduce their environmental pollution.

pmc-13603860.title: Molecular Signaling Pathways in Depression and Neuroinflammation: Focus on New Pathophysiological Proteins and Therapeutic Compounds
pmc-13603860.creator: Hyeong Jae Kim, Jeong-Hee Kim, Young-Don Son, Jong-Hoon Kim, Jeong Hee Hong
pmc-13603860.description: Neuroinflammation is a multifaceted process in which specific biomolecules (such as pro-inflammatory cytokines and signaling proteins) act as primary mediators of neuropsychiatric disorders, including depression. Despite growing evidence, the precise interconnected cascades within these neuroinflammatory signaling pathways and their regulatory proteins remain to be fully elucidated, which presents a significant unmet need for targeted therapeutic strategies with clear mechanistic validation.

pmc-13718368.title: Precise Sequence Control and Thermal Characterization of N‑Substituted Maleimide Copolymers Containing Hydrazine Structure
pmc-13718368.creator: Akikazu Matsumoto, Natsuki Okada, Yuki Nakai, Tomohiro Suzuki, Yasuhito Suzuki
pmc-13718368.description: N-Substituted maleimides are highly reactive and have been used for the synthesis of various thermoresistant polymer materials by radical copolymerization with vinyl monomers. In this study, we synthesized several maleimide monomers with N-amino substituents, i.e., N-(N′,N′-dimethylamino)­maleimide, N-(N′,N′-diphenylamino)­maleimide, and N-morpholinomaleimide, using N,N-disubstituted hydrazine compounds and maleic anhydride as the starting materials.
